text:
jess: Drafting release notes and changelog entries for Routing/Variant pins + SDK snippet cleanup. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5007. Needs short Dedicated migration note and a one-paragraph "what to expect" section. PTAL
omar: quick scan: looks good. two requests: (A) call out the change to JS SDK method shape (client.text.generate -> client.text.createStream for streaming use-cases) and (B) add a short example showing how to pin a model variant in Dedicated via the console + API
jess: added a JS snippet and console screenshot note. also added API pin example.
ryan: found a small problem in the Python snippet  the import uses the compatibility shim `from redwood.sdk import Client`  prefer `from redwood import Client` to match v1 packages. also add a note about auth scopes required for variant pinning (dedicated:workflow:write)
jess: fixed Python imports and added scopes note. thanks.
link-bot: linkcheck: /guides/dedicated/pinning -> 404. Suggested replacement: /guides/dedicated/variant-pinning. Also external https://models.thirdparty/compat -> 404; suggest converting to advisory text (do not link)
jess: updated the links and removed the dead external link. put compatibility table inline instead.
docs-lint-bot: markdown-lint: MD013 long lines in relnotes/routing-v2.md: lines 22, 46. Also codeblock language missing for a bash example in migration.md
jess: wrapped long lines and added language tags.
omar: additional suggestion: include a small "preflight eval" checklist for customers switching variants: 1) run canonical eval set, 2) compare top-k probabilities for 50 prompts, 3) watch for hallucination regressions on domain prompts
jess: added preflight checklist bullets and an example evaluation curl script: ```bash
# run a small eval set against a pinned variant
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/evals/run \
  -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b-quant","prompts":["Prompt A","Prompt B"]}'
```
ryan: small nit: evals API should be /v1/evals.batch_run in the new schema
jess: fixed endpoint path. thanks.
link-bot: linkcheck (preview): all internal links OK. external advisory notes validated.
docs-lint-bot: snippet-tests: JS streaming snippet flaky locally (timeout). Recommend adding a short note to set STREAM_TIMEOUT=20s in test harness
jess: added STREAM_TIMEOUT note to CI config in docs repo and retriggered tests.
docs-lint-bot: snippet-tests: passed on retry.
omar: rollout recommendation: use ringed rollout: ring 0 (internal): 100% immediate, ring 1 (beta orgs): 10% for 6h, ring 2 (public canary): 25% for 12h, ring 3 (general): 100% after monitoring good for 24h. rollback triggers: error rate > 0.8% sustained 10m OR p95 latency increase > 30%
jess: added rollout plan and ops rollback snippet (Prometheus alert examples + Grafana dashboard links). also included a "known issues" callout: - streaming embeddings token offsets may shift by 1 token for a handful of legacy quantized builds - fallback to quantized variants can change punctuation in ~0.5% of outputs for some prompts. recommended mitigations: pin variant or run quick eval set.
ryan: propose adding a one-line "how customers can pre-warm prefix cache at scale" guidance: recommend using warmup client at 5 RPS per GPU and ramp for 10 minutes, include backoff on 429s
jess: added warmup guidance and a small bash warmup loop snippet: ```bash
# safe warmup: 5 RPS per GPU, backoff on 429s
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate \
    -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b","input":"warmup"}' || true
  sleep 0.2
done
```
link-bot: preview URL: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/5007/relnotes-routing-variant-pinning
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-03-24 08:00 UTC. (auto-post to #announcements and #support)
omar: LGTM. Also, small editorial ask: make the changelog bullet concise: e.g., "Routing v2: adaptive routing with variant pinning; graceful quantized fallbacks (see docs)"
jess: updated changelog bullet and will merge in 10 minutes unless objections. Thanks all! :shipit:
